# Schedule

Fridays 12:30 to 1:45 PM in 1315 TNRB. Thirteen sessions, Sep 4 through Dec 4. Each session is
30 minutes of leadership development followed by a 45 minute project roundtable.

| # | Date | Leadership development (30 min) | Roundtable (45 min) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fri, Sep 4 | Kickoff: the operating model, roles, expectations | Semester priorities by club |
| 2 | Fri, Sep 11 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 3 | Fri, Sep 18 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 4 | Fri, Sep 25 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 5 | Fri, Oct 2 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 6 | Fri, Oct 9 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 7 | Fri, Oct 16 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 8 | Fri, Oct 23 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 9 | Fri, Oct 30 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 10 | Fri, Nov 6 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 11 | Fri, Nov 13 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 12 | Fri, Nov 20 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |
| 13 | Fri, Dec 4 | TBD | Club and presidency updates |

The leadership development column is a placeholder except for session 1. The operating model
names three skill areas to draw from: influence, conflict, and managing up, alongside guest
speakers and case discussions.

## Semester Dates

| Date | What |
|---|---|
| Wed, Sep 2 | First day of classes (this course first meets Fri, Sep 4) |
| Thu, Sep 10 | Add/drop deadline |
| Tue, Nov 24 | Withdraw deadline |

There is no final exam. Nov 27 is the only Friday lost to the holiday calendar.
